2842-3899-4681-5170.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2557-6753-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Parallel Lives and Exalted Sunborn.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
2557-6753-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

3115-3557-4477.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3375-4399-4770-6097.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4770-6097.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

670-1619-1734-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6145.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Passageway Seer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning Passageway Seer from exile to the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Passageway Seer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Passageway Seer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

4231-4659-7282.notablePrerequisites: You control a Food, Clue or Treasure.
4231-4659-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, targeting a Food, Treasure or Clue you control, but creating one of each due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, Treasure and Clue, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
4231-4659-7282.notes: As mana allows, you can skip step 2.

647-1368-3755-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
647-1368-3755-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

348-2178-2577-7422.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Zombie, and at least one additional creature except Gravecrawler or the Zombie.
348-2178-2577-7422.description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler and any other creature.
When the creatures die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping itself.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, and causing you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

486-2388-4428-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
486-2388-4428-6587.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2646-3967-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2646-3967-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

465-2511-4681.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2816-6747-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
2816-6747-7070.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Umbral Mantle ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat.

304-1978-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
304-1978-7013.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Tough Cookie.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

856-3263-4659-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3234-3293-5147-5226.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5147-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5147-5226.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

132-4306-4896.notablePrerequisites: Your combined devotion to white and blue is at least nine.
132-4306-4896.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding an amount of {W} or {U} equal to your devotion to that color.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
132-4306-4896.notes: When adding mana, alternate what colors you add, and add the color that'll make the most mana first. The mana needed will be the opposite color of whatever you add originally.

2558-3490-4050-6701-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-4050-6701-6798.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

1315-2173-4423-6491-6701.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
1315-2173-4423-6491-6701.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
1315-2173-4423-6491-6701.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
1315-2173-4423-6491-6701.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2054-4131-4222-6657.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Basalt Monolith's ability three times.
Resolve a copy of Basalt Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Gogo.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-2438-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-2438-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2534-3817-4050-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

1115-2105-3204-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1115-2105-3204-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

1405-2923-3967.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
1405-2923-3967.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

116-4644-5329.description:
Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

717-4798-5435-5686.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

513-1306--47.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C}{C} from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast using {C} or less, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

618-660-2178.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Treva's Attendant with haste.
Activate the Treva's Attendant token by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{W}{U}.
When the Treva's Attendant token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1110-3059-3231.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2103-2223-2707.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Anurid Scavenger triggers, causing you to put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your draw step, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat.

3850-4875.description: Activate Realmbreaker's second ability by paying {10}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search for all creatures in your library, as they are all Praetors due to Conspiracy, and put them onto the battlefield.

1760-3603-4364.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Aurelia.
1760-3603-4364.description:
Cast Surge to Victory by paying {4}{R}{R}, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving creatures you control +1/+0 until end of turn.
Declare Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aurelia.
Surge to Victory triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

224-1193-1528.notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one basic Mountain.
224-1193-1528.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting any permanent.
Holding priority, activate any Mountain you control by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a copy of Mythos of Illuna targeting any basic Mountain you control.
Resolve the Mythos of Illuna copy, creating a token copy of the basic Mountain.
The basic Mountain token enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Repeat from step 2.

338-1496-3197.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Herd Baloth.
You have a way to gain life.
338-1496-3197.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth equal to the amount of life gained.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

141-1638-2060-3129.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Naru Meha and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Naru Meha from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Primal Vigor.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

413-803-3413.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
